_comment: Cost inputs for the cost-aware scheduler. Edit these to match YOUR real rig and YOUR real cloud quotes. All prices in USD. Nothing here talks to any marketplace; these are the compute options the scheduler weighs for your own authorized jobs.

electricity._comment: Marginal cost of running your local hardware. Used to price local CPU/GPU placements.

localDevices.label: Local CPU
localDevices._comment: Pure-CPU host. Slow for most hash modes; cost is only electricity, no cloud spend.

localDevices.label: Local GPU rig
localDevices._comment: Set available:true and tune powerWatts if the host has a crackable GPU. Zero $/hr beyond electricity.

cloudInstances.label: 1x RTX 4090 (spot)
cloudInstances._comment: Representative community-cloud spot price. Replace usdPerHour with your actual quote.
